description: This Java class defines a request type 'DeviceIsChildRequest' used in a mock Zigbee core environment to determine if a device is a child device based on its EUI-64 identifier.

classes.name: DeviceIsChildRequest
classes.description: A request class that checks if a specific device identified by EUI-64 is a child device within the mock Zigbee core environment.

methods.name: DeviceIsChildRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializes the request with request ID and device EUI-64.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the request logic to determine if the device with the given EUI-64 is a child device and sends the appropriate response.
